name: Bulk Wholsale Dynamic Pricing Buttons for WooCommerce
author: WPSAAD

sections.description:
🚀 Increase WooCommerce Sales with Bulk & Wholesale Pricing!

The Bulk Wholesale Dynamic Pricing Buttons for WooCommerce plugin makes it easy to offer bulk discounts, dynamic pricing, and wholesale pricing strategies for your WooCommerce store. Instead of complex pricing rules, this plugin dynamically displays pricing buttons based on quantity selection, improving customer experience and increasing conversions.

🔹 Key Features:
✔ Dynamic Pricing Buttons – Display bulk and wholesale price variations directly on the product page.
✔ Automatic Quantity Discounts – Set pricing discounts based on quantity selection.
✔ Works with Simple & Variable Products – Apply bulk pricing for different product variations.
✔ Customizable Button Labels – Change discount labels and button text to fit your pricing strategy.
✔ Seamless WooCommerce Integration – Fully compatible with WooCommerce.
✔ Lightweight & Fast – No unnecessary bloating, ensuring fast page load speeds.

📢 Perfect for:
– Wholesale Stores offering discounts for bulk buyers.
– Retailers with tiered pricing strategies.
– Businesses running special promotions or quantity-based discounts.

💼 Free Features:

  • ✔ Display quantity-based pricing buttons on the product page
  • ✔ Set fixed prices for each quantity tier
  • ✔ Customize button colors and hover styles
  • ✔ Supports simple and variable products
  • ✔ Fully integrated with WooCommerce cart pricing

💎 Pro Features:

  • ✅ Conditional Pricing Logic (≥, ≤, =, >, <) per quantity range
  • ✅ Tiered Pricing Button Display with logic-based rendering
  • ✅ Dynamic price update in cart with advanced logic
  • ✅ Per Piece vs Per Quantity calculation modes
  • ✅ Admin panel to customize logic behavior and colors
  • ✅ Premium support and updates

📌 How It Works:
1. Set Bulk Pricing Rules – Configure pricing buttons via the WooCommerce product settings.
2. Dynamic Price Display – Buttons will show price adjustments based on quantity selection.
3. Customer Chooses Quantity – Shoppers select their desired quantity and see updated prices instantly.
4. Auto-Applies at Checkout – Discounted pricing is automatically applied when customers add items to the cart.

sections.installation:
1. Install & Activate: Upload the plugin via Plugins > Add New, or install from WordPress.org.
  2. Configure Settings: Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Bulk Pricing and set your rules.
  3. Enjoy Dynamic Pricing! Your store now offers bulk and wholesale discounts automatically!
sections.faq:
🔹 Does this plugin work with all WooCommerce products?

Yes! It supports simple and variable products in WooCommerce.

🔹 Can I set different price levels for different quantities?

Yes! You can configure tiered pricing based on quantity selection.

🔹 Will this modify my WooCommerce product prices?

No! The pricing changes only on the front-end display while keeping product prices intact in WooCommerce.

🔹 Is it compatible with other WooCommerce extensions?

Yes! This plugin works seamlessly with most WooCommerce add-ons and themes.

🔹 Not working?

  • Ensure WooCommerce is installed and activated.
  • Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Bulk Pricing and configure rules.
  • Clear cache if changes aren’t appearing.
